title: Spacetech firm SatSure raises Rs 60 Cr from Antariksh fund
summary: SatSure’s Rs 60 crore investment from India’s dedicated spacetech fund will support satellite development, AI capabilities and global expansion as the country’s private space industry continues to gather momentum.
